g.text: PARALLEL EXTENSION | Feature selection from 1,028 claims categories
Saved monthly counts → 12-month totals → latest TRAIN snapshot per patient → quality checks → three TRAIN-fold selectors
FILTER: mutual information + redundancy pruning (100) | WRAPPER: shortlist + RFE (50) | EMBEDDED: elastic net + trees (100)
Compared with a fixed L2-logistic evaluator: AP ≈ 0.193 / 0.195 / 0.193 versus 0.156 for all eligible features.
These are feature-selection results, not Transformer results. Selected-feature Transformer comparison is the next experiment.
